brand.name: KJAPP
brand.product_definition: Premium Nordic AI-assisted taxi and fleet platform
brand.core_principle: Mobility first. AI invisible until useful.
avoid: large AI orbs as primary identity
emoji or Unicode symbols as production icons

typography.rule: Do not use Fraunces, editorial serif, Outfit or decorative display fonts in core product UI.
typography.numeric_rule: Use tabular numerals for prices, ETA, earnings, countdowns and clock times.

materials.glass_rule: Use controlled translucency and subtle 1px borders. No heavy outer glow.

voice.rule: Voice accelerates the standard booking flow; it does not replace the visible booking flow.

vehicle_classes.name: KJAPP XL
vehicle_classes.intent: larger SUV/MPV with obvious space difference

customer.commission_rule: Never show 14%, 86% or partner commission marketing inside Customer.

driver.experience: glance-first operational cockpit with low distraction
driver.safety_rule: Avoid complex interactions while driving; critical state must be understandable with a short glance.
driver.commission_rule: Never show 14%, 86% or commission marketing inside Driver. Earnings may show actual gross, KJAPP service fee, net, tips, adjustments and payout.

maps.rule: Use a real map engine and realistic cartography. Never ship Figma-style pseudo roads.
maps.customer: quiet dark map focused on pickup, destination, route and driver
maps.driver: higher operational contrast with route, ETA, traffic, heading, demand and GPS uncertainty
maps.route: one clear cyan primary route with restrained glow
maps.provider_strategy: Keep a provider abstraction; evaluate Google Maps and Mapbox on Norwegian address quality, ETA, navigation, styling, latency and EEA terms.

ai.role: structured booking intent and natural-language acceleration

fleet.brand: same KJAPP dark/cyan identity as Customer and Driver

hero.headline: Din flåte. Ett system.
hero.body: Administrer sjåfører, kjøretøy, dokumenter, turer og oppgjør fra KJAPP Fleet.

fleet.marketing_rule: 14% may appear only as partner/marketing information, never as the product identity or inside Customer/Driver.

components.naming_rule: Use semantic names and variants, not color-based names.

accessibility.rule: Never communicate online/offline, selected/unselected, error/success only through color.

quality_gate: No placeholder map or pseudo roads
Loading, empty, error and offline behavior specified
Driver critical state understandable with a short glance
AI reduces steps without removing user control
